name: Radiant Concordat
identity: Porcelain rail-gun infantry and battlesuits, blood-lotus priests, and hulking gore-ogre auxiliaries. Poor in melee, deadly when spotted targets line up, and the ogres stand in front of the porcelain.

rules.name: Crimson-Lotus Spotters · Gilded Bulwark
rules.description: Spot: an unengaged Concordat unit may use 1 Action to Spot a visible enemy unit; the next friendly unit to Shoot that enemy this round gets +1 to Hit and [IGNORES COVER] (one Spot per enemy unit per round). Bulwark: once per round, when an enemy unit declares a Charge against a Concordat Class 1–2 unit within 3″ of Gore-Brutes or Gore-Ogres, those ogres may make a 3″ move to engage the charger before the Charge roll.

rules.name: Gamble — Blood-Offering
rules.description: When a unit Spots within 6″ of a Blood-Lotus Prior, the Prior may inflict D3 Fatal Wounds on a friendly ogre unit within 3″: the spotted attack also gains [SHREDDING WOUNDS]. (Risk: durability (friendly).)

detachments.name: Patient Hunter
detachments.playstyle: Hold back, spot, and break them late.

rules.name: Patient Hunter
rules.description: In Rounds 3–4, ranged weapons gain [ONSLAUGHT 1] against spotted units. Units that did not Move get +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) against ranged attacks.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Patience
enhancements.description: **Concordat Strategos** only. The attached unit's ranged weapons gain [IMPALING HITS].

enhancements.name: Recon Uplink
enhancements.description: **Lotus Pathfinder-Priest** only. Free Spot twice per round.

stratagems.name: Ambush Volley
stratagems.turn: A unit that did not Move Shoots

stratagems.name: Spring the Trap
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit ends a move within 12″ of two Concordat units
stratagems.effect: One of them Shoots it now (once per round).

stratagems.name: Fall Back to Cover
stratagems.effect: It may make a 3″ move before the Charge roll.

detachments.name: Killing Blow
detachments.playstyle: Go early: rapid advance and close-range volleys.

rules.name: Killing Blow
rules.description: In Rounds 1–2, ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and +1 PEN within 12″.

stratagems.name: Close the Net
stratagems.turn: Two units Shoot the same target

stratagems.name: Jump-Jet Strike
stratagems.effect: It may make a 5″ move afterward.

detachments.name: Gore-Brute Retinue
detachments.playstyle: Ogres in front, porcelain behind, blood-priests feeding both.

rules.name: Gilded Bulwark
rules.description: Gore units within 3″ of a Porcelain unit get +1 Attack in melee; Porcelain units within 3″ of a Gore unit are [STEALTH].

enhancements.name: Nectar-Censer
enhancements.description: **Blood-Lotus Caste Prior** only. Friendly ogre units within 6″ get +1 Attack on a round they charged.

stratagems.name: Meat-Shield
stratagems.turn: A Porcelain unit within 3″ of ogres is targeted
stratagems.effect: The ogres take the attack instead.

stratagems.name: Gore-Charge
stratagems.turn: An ogre unit declares a Charge
stratagems.effect: +2″ to the roll and Crushing Impact for 0 CP.

stratagems.name: Blood-Tithe
stratagems.turn: An ogre unit suffers a Blood-Offering
stratagems.effect: It heals D3 MIGHT at the End of Round.
